description.zh: 事件查询时间区间的开始时间，该时间不得早于频道实际的创建时间，不得早于30天之前。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: Start Time of the event query time range. This time must not be earlier than the actual channel Creation Time and must not be earlier than 30 days ago. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh: 事件查询时间区间的结束时间，该时间不得晚于频道释放时间。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空，表示获取当前时间。
description.en: End time of the event query time range. This time must not be later than the channel release time. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.

description.zh: 用户ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: List of User IDs, separated by commas (,).

title.zh: 获取端对端用户事件列表

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取端对端用户事件列表。例如：在事件列表中您可以获取事件名称、事件类型等信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to retrieve the end-to-end user management event List. For example, in the Event List, you can obtain information such as Event Name and Type.  

### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The per-user QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second. If this limit is exceeded, API Calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
